QUOTE: An unknown top-level section in `.clew.yaml` is refused by name. A misspelled key inside an inline `options` value is also refused, so it cannot read as a valid but unused mapping.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unknown sections are refused by name, but it doesn't mention the allowed set. Its stated reason (it "cannot read as a valid but unused mapping") is not the item's reason, which is that an ignored section builds with defaults while the declaration is reported as honoured.
